matter_background.original: Mark Perera gifted his house and land containing 20 perches situated in Rajagiriya to his son Peter Perera subject to life interest of Donor and his wife .Present Market value of the house and land is 5 million (Rs 5,000,000/).According to the opinion of Commissioner of Revenue Western Province the stamp duty value is Rs 6,500,000/.
